description: This Kotlin source file defines the SearchFragment class, a dialog fragment that provides voice and text search functionality for workouts within the fitness app. It manages UI components, handles voice recognition intents, and updates workout results displayed in a grid.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment enabling voice search and text filtering of workouts, displaying results in a grid and handling user interactions such as voice input and activity results.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Initializes the dialog UI, sets up search and voice recognition handlers, and displays the dialog.

methods.name: launchPlayer
methods.description: Starts the PlayerActivity with the selected workout.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from voice recognition, updates the search box, and triggers a search based on recognized speech.
